description: In every PA-model, an accepted original-language sentence has no occurrence of any requested auxiliary constant.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.isSentence_occursAux_zero.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  (j e : M)
  (he :
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.isSentence.value ![e] =
      Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M 1) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.occursAux.value ![j, e] =
    Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M
